load_pretrained_model: load a pre-trained fairseq model using torch.hub with from_pretrained and checkpoint_file arguments
use_bpe_interface: use the BPEHubInterface to encode and decode sentences with byte-pair encoding via torch.hub
use_tokenizer_interface: use the TokenizerHubInterface to tokenize and detokenize text via torch.hub
generate_with_model: generate translated or sampled text from a loaded fairseq model using the translate or sample method
score_sentences: score a list of sentences using a loaded fairseq model's score method for language modeling
